content.text:
# Packed forwarding images: protocol 3

This is an offline exact compiler/planner for small forwarding shards. The
objective below models vector comparisons, burst sharing and resident pages;
its units are defined here and are not real CPU cycles or cache measurements.
There is no throughput score. Any layout attaining the exact minimum pair is
accepted. Larger routing histories may collapse to small forwarding shards.

Read one UTF-8 JSON request through stdin to EOF, write one JSON result and
exit zero. Reject duplicate object keys, NaN/Infinity, extra JSON values, wrong
types/keys or invalid domain/bounds with exactly {"error":"invalid"}, exiting
zero with no partial results. JSON integers never include booleans or floats.
Whitespace/key order is irrelevant; stdout contains no other text.

## Request and forwarding semantics

The root has exactly "cases", an array. Each case has exactly:
initial, transactions, bursts, cache_pages, costs.

    {"cases":[{"initial":[["::/0",3],["2001:db8::/128",7]],
      "transactions":[[["erase","2001:db8::/128"]]],
      "bursts":[{"version":0,"repeat":5,"addresses":["2001:db8::","::"]}],
      "cache_pages":2,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":8,"decode":[0,1,2]}}]}

initial is an ordered list of [prefix,hop]. A prefix is an IPv6 address and
/L, where L is decimal 0..128, without leading zero except "0". Mask host
bits to identify the route. Case/spelling/host-bit aliases are the same route;
last initial row wins. Hops are integers 0..2147483647; hop 0 is a real match.
Addresses use colon/hex notation, optionally ::, either letter case; forbid
IPv4, dotted suffixes, zone IDs, surrounding whitespace, and strings longer
than 64 characters (prefix length included for prefixes).

Version 0 is the initial FIB. A transaction is an ordered list of
["set",prefix,hop] or ["erase",prefix]. Set replaces that exact normalized
route; erase removes it or is a no-op if absent. Each transaction publishes
a new immutable version, including an empty/no-op transaction. A lookup uses
the matching route with greatest length; no match yields null. Preserve
covered/same-hop routes so that later withdrawal reveals the right fallback.
All 128 address bits matter. Different cases have separate histories.

A burst has exactly version, repeat, addresses. Version is any committed
version of this case; repeat is 1..1000000 and weights the entire burst.
addresses is an ordered list of 0..64 IPv6 addresses without /L. Repetitions
of one address in a burst count as multiple comparisons but one node fetch.
An empty burst makes no visits or fetches.

cache_pages is 0..12, shared across ALL versions in THIS case. Cached node
pages of different versions count separately, even for identical images.
costs has exactly hit, miss, decode: hit is 1..16; miss is hit..256;
decode is a length-3 array of integers 0..16, indexed by encoding mode.
Costs and page budgets do not carry between cases.

## Canonical forwarding runs and result shape

Let U=2^128. A bound is lowercase hex with exactly 32 digits for 0..U-1;
U is exactly "100000000000000000000000000000000" (1 followed by 32 zeros).
For a valid request emit {"cases":[result,...]} in input order. A result has
exactly versions, changes, bursts, objective. versions has version 0 first
and each later version in order. A version has exactly starts, hops, image.

starts is strictly increasing, starts at 32 zero digits, never includes U,
and has the same nonzero length R as hops. Run i is [starts[i],starts[i+1]),
or [starts[i],U) for the final run; hops[i] is the LPM value everywhere in it.
Adjacent equal hops MUST be coalesced, irrespective of route identity or
length. An empty FIB is one full-domain null run. These arrays are unique.

changes has one array per transaction, comparing versions v and v+1. A row
is [start,end,old_hop,new_hop] for a nonempty half-open region with different
forwarding values. Cover all and only changed regions, sorted/disjoint,
coalescing adjacent rows with the same ordered hop pair. This is forwarding
change, not a route edit log. Bounds include U when needed.

Each output burst is an answer array, corresponding to the input burst's
addresses once (do not expand repeat). An answer is [hop_or_null,run_index,path].
path lists byte offsets of all visited nodes in that version's image,
root through leaf. Traversal and predecessor selection are specified below.

objective is [work,image_pages], the exact pair for the submitted images.
Minimize work first; among equal work minimize image_pages. There is no
further tie-break. Any valid layout/caching attaining that pair is accepted.

## Binary image and legal ordered trees

image is a lowercase even-length hexadecimal string encoding the complete
byte image, without spaces. All numeric binary fields are UNSIGNED LITTLE
ENDIAN, including 128-bit bases/keys. Each image has:
a 64-byte header, breadth-first node records, then a separate hop array.
Every record starts on a 64-byte boundary. No pointers, sharing, omitted
nodes, trailing bytes, arbitrary gaps or extra padding pages are allowed.

Header byte offsets:

| Offset | Size | Required value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 4 | ASCII FIDX |
| 4 | 1 | 2 |
| 5 | 3 | zero |
| 8 | 4 | R |
| 12 | 4 | number of nodes |
| 16 | 4 | byte offset of hop array |
| 20 | 4 | total image bytes |
| 24 | 40 | zero |

Root starts at offset 64 and covers run indices [0,R).
A leaf covers 1..8 consecutive runs. An internal node has 2..9 children
whose nonempty consecutive run ranges partition the parent's range in order.
Every node is reachable once; the structure is a tree. Node records are in
breadth-first traversal order, children left to right. A leaf need not be
full and the tree need not have equal leaf depths.

Every node's fixed header is 32 bytes:

| Offset | Size | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 1 | kind: 0 internal, 1 leaf |
| 1 | 1 | encoding mode: 0, 1 or 2 |
| 2 | 1 | cached: 0 or 1 |
| 3 | 1 | zero |
| 4 | 2 | lo: first covered run index |
| 6 | 2 | span: number of covered runs |
| 8 | 2 | count: child count for internal, span for leaf |
| 10 | 2 | zero |
| 12 | 4 | allocated node bytes |
| 16 | 16 | base: numeric starts[lo], in every mode |

Payload starts at byte 32 of the record. For an internal node it first
contains count child offsets, each uint32, then count-1 separator keys.
Separator c-1 is starts[child_c.lo] for child c=1..count-1; child 0 has no
separator. A leaf has no child offsets: its payload contains all span run
starts in order. Key payload widths are [16,8,4] bytes for modes [0,1,2].
Mode 0 stores full absolute keys; mode 1 stores key-base as uint64; mode 2
stores key-base as uint32.

Mode 0 is always legal. Mode 1 is legal ONLY if the largest covered run start
minus base is <2^64. Mode 2 requires that difference <2^32. This condition
applies to ALL run starts covered by the node, not only its separator keys.
There is no overflow/wrapping or truncation. A single-run leaf can use any mode.
No other prefix/key compression is permitted.

If K is the number of key payload entries and b is child count (0 for leaf),
used bytes = 32+4*b+K*width[mode]. Allocated bytes MUST be the smallest multiple
of 64 >= used bytes; all remaining record bytes are zero. Internal K=b-1;
leaf K=span. No node stores next hops.

The hop array begins immediately after the final node record. It stores
R uint32 values in run order: 0xffffffff means null; other values are the
corresponding hop (0..2147483647). Pad this array with zeros to the smallest
multiple of 64 bytes that contains it. image_pages is the sum of total image
bytes/64 over all versions, including headers and padded hop arrays.

At an internal node, c is the number of separator keys <= the destination;
take child c. Equality goes right. At the leaf select the greatest stored
start <= the destination, giving the run and the hop-array entry. The tree
must correctly route every address in [0,U), not just the supplied workload.
The declared run ranges, keys, base, child offsets and hop entries must agree
exactly with the canonical forwarding runs. No artificial U key is stored.

## Burst-aware work and global resident budget

For a node covering runs [i,j) in version v, define:
Q = sum over bursts for v of repeat * number of addresses whose run is in [i,j).
T = sum over bursts for v of repeat * indicator(at least one such address).
Let P=allocated node bytes/64, K=its key count, and lanes=[4,8,16][mode].
The node's work contribution is exactly:

    P * (hit if cached else miss) * T
      + (ceil(K/lanes) + decode[mode]) * Q

Sum over ALL nodes of ALL version images for work. Headers and hop-array
access are excluded from work: their cost is outside this defined objective.
They still count toward image_pages. All computations are exact integers.
cached applies to the WHOLE node and consumes P resident pages; partial-node
caching is illegal. Sum P over every cached node in every version must be
<=cache_pages for that case. No demand-fetch state persists between bursts.

Tree topology, leaf grouping, encoding modes and resident selections all
participate in the global optimum. A locally minimum image or per-version
cache allocation is not necessarily the minimum for the whole case.
Output values are recomputed by verification; self-reported work is not proof.
There is always a feasible layout (for example uncached full-key nodes).
No infeasibility result is required.

## Validation, scale and submission bounds

Input <=16 MiB; 0..4 cases; at most 7 transactions/8 versions per case;
at most 30000 active normalized routes at any intermediate state;
at most 60000 initial rows plus changes across the whole request;
at most 60000 active route entries summed over all committed versions;
at most 256 bursts and 8192 address occurrences across the whole request.
In addition, every committed version's canonical R must be <=64, and the
sum of R over ALL committed versions of ALL cases must be <=128.
Exceeding those forwarding-run bounds is an invalid whole request, even if
all other bounds hold. The starter parser does not implement that domain
check: it requires the forwarding compilation. Every maximum applies to the
entire request, not individually reset per version unless explicitly stated.

These are small exact-planning shards, not a full Internet FIB benchmark.
The cost model and variable-depth/relative-offset image are software
abstractions; no actual SIMD execution, hardware cache residency, packet
forwarding, concurrent reclamation or physical throughput is measured.

# Scalar native stages

Submit main.py AND engine.cpp under submission/. The JSON compiler contract
is PROTOCOL.md; the same submission also provides the three native stages
below. They exercise the interval compiler, image builder and actual packed
lookup kernel independently. Native stages do not optimize a plan.

The build interface is exactly:

    g++ -O2 -std=c++17 /workspace/submission/engine.cpp -o /workspace/tmp/engine

engine.cpp is one translation unit and may include supporting .hpp/.cpp files
from the submission tree. The offline GCC toolchain supports unsigned
__int128. Require no ISA extension beyond baseline x86-64. The provided
engine.hpp retains scalar interval/tree code with legacy 64-bit and fixed-depth
limitations; packed integration and lookup are unfinished. Extend it to meet
these interfaces. Function/class names and implementation strategy are free.

A native invocation reads one whitespace-delimited ASCII request through EOF,
writes the specified token sequence to stdout and exits zero. Whitespace
between tokens is arbitrary. Decimal output integers use ordinary canonical
notation; keys are lowercase 32-digit unsigned hexadecimal. Hop -1 means null;
hop 0 is a real next hop. No diagnostics belong on stdout.

Native requests are structurally valid inputs satisfying the conditions below.
Malformed/out-of-domain native input has no required response. The JSON entry
still must handle every invalid request as specified in PROTOCOL.md. Each
native operation, including needed compilation, has the same 120-second wall,
process/memory/file/output and scratch restrictions as a whole JSON request.
Native input is at most 16 MiB; stdout 64 MiB and stderr 1 MiB. Public limits
are not reset per route, node or address. Compiler products stay in scratch.

## ATLAS

Input tokens:

    ATLAS n
    start length hop                 (n rows)

n is 0..30000. Each start is a 32-digit key, length is 0..128, and hop is
0..2147483647. Starts have already had host bits masked. The normalized
(start,length) routes are unique and may arrive in any order. This is one
RIB version; there are no transaction commands in this stage.

Output tokens:

    R
    start hop                        (R rows)

Return the unique maximal forwarding runs defined by PROTOCOL.md, starting at
zero and coalescing adjacent equal next hops. Null is -1. The empty RIB has
one full-domain null run. This standalone stage may return more than 64 runs
(at most 2*n+1); the JSON compiler enforces its own per-version/whole-request
run limits after compilation. No artificial upper-domain endpoint is emitted.

## PACK

Input tokens:

    PACK R N A
    start hop                        (R rows)
    lo span mode cached b child_id... (N rows)
    address                          (A rows)

1<=R<=64, 1<=N<=2*R-1 and 0<=A<=8192. Starts/hops describe valid canonical
runs, with -1 for null and other hops 0..2147483647. Node IDs are row indices
0..N-1 in breadth-first order; ID0 is the root. A row has exactly b child IDs.
b=0 denotes a leaf; otherwise b is 2..9. All node ranges, partitions, modes,
residency flags and ordering obey the legal-tree rules in PROTOCOL.md. There
is no optimization requirement or cache budget for this standalone stage;
its supplied cached bits are serialized as given. Addresses are 32-digit keys.

Output tokens:

    image
    hop run path_length node_offset... (A rows)

Build the unique exact FIDX version2 byte image for THAT supplied layout,
including all required minimal allocation/zero padding. image is lowercase
hexadecimal. Report each actual packed lookup's hop, zero-based run index and
root-to-leaf byte-offset path. Layout choices are inputs, not selected here.

## TRACE

Input tokens:

    TRACE A
    image
    address                          (A rows)

0<=A<=8192. image is ANY valid FIDX version2 image for 1..64 canonical runs,
including arbitrary legal topology, modes, cached flags and next hops. Its
bytes are the complete source of keys/children/hops; no RIB, starts array,
layout objects or process state is supplied. Apply predecessor/equality rules
from PROTOCOL.md. Return A rows of hop, run, path_length and node_offset tokens
in input address order, in the same form as PACK's answer rows. With A=0 the
correct native output has no tokens. Different invocations share no state.

The public command remains:

    python3 check.py submission/main.py

It runs the JSON candidate in bounded real children, then compiles engine.cpp
as another bounded child and runs the small .native fixtures. It uses only
public files. Empty/nonJSON/nonzero JSON responses fail; incorrect/extra native
tokens or a failed native build/run fail. These fixtures are sanity checks;
all published stage and JSON semantics remain mandatory at full bounds.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Public sanity checks. The program under test is always a real child."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import selectors
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from audit import audit
from process_guard import (ChildCleanupError, CleanupProfileError,
                           prepare_controller, reap_group, restrict_child)

WALL = 120
STDOUT = 64 * 1024 * 1024
STDERR = 1024 * 1024


def unique(pairs):
    out = {}
    for k, v in pairs:
        if k in out:
            raise ValueError("duplicate output key")
        out[k] = v
    return out


def reject_constant(value):
    raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON")


def decode(data):
    return json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique,
                      parse_constant=reject_constant)


def same(a, b):
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return False
    if type(a) is dict:
        return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(same(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list:
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(same(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return a == b


def child_limits():
    os.setsid()
    for which, values in [
        (resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (180, 181)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_AS, (2 * 1024**3, 2 * 1024**3)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (256, 256)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_NPROC, (64, 64)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (64 * 1024**2, 64 * 1024**2)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_CORE, (0, 0)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_STACK, (8 * 1024**2, 8 * 1024**2)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_MEMLOCK, (65536, 65536)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_MSGQUEUE, (819200, 819200)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_SIGPENDING, (4096, 4096)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_NICE, (0, 0)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_RTPRIO, (0, 0)),
    ]:
        resource.setrlimit(which, values)
    restrict_child()


def run_child(entry, data, *, argv=None, raw=False):
    prepare_controller()
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
               PYTHONHASHSEED="0", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
               OMP_NUM_THREADS="1", MKL_NUM_THREADS="1", TMPDIR="/workspace/tmp")
    p = subprocess.Popen(argv or [sys.executable, "-B", str(entry)],
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                         stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, close_fds=True,
                         preexec_fn=child_limits)
    selector = selectors.DefaultSelector()
    output = [bytearray(), bytearray()]
    offset = 0
    deadline = time.monotonic() + WALL
    try:
        for stream in [p.stdin, p.stdout, p.stderr]:
            os.set_blocking(stream.fileno(), False)
        selector.register(p.stdin, selectors.EVENT_WRITE, -1)
        selector.register(p.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ, 0)
        selector.register(p.stderr, selectors.EVENT_READ, 1)
        while selector.get_map():
            left = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if left <= 0:
                raise ValueError("child wall limit")
            for key, _ in selector.select(min(0.1, left)):
                stream, channel = key.fileobj, key.data
                if channel == -1:
                    if offset == len(data):
                        selector.unregister(stream)
                        stream.close()
                        continue
                    try:
                        offset += os.write(stream.fileno(), data[offset:offset + 65536])
                    except BlockingIOError:
                        pass
                    except BrokenPipeError:
                        selector.unregister(stream)
                        stream.close()
                else:
                    cap = [STDOUT, STDERR][channel]
                    try:
                        chunk = os.read(stream.fileno(), min(65536, cap - len(output[channel]) + 1))
                    except BlockingIOError:
                        continue
                    if not chunk:
                        selector.unregister(stream)
                        stream.close()
                    else:
                        output[channel].extend(chunk)
                        if len(output[channel]) > cap:
                            raise ValueError("child output limit")
        try:
            code = p.wait(timeout=max(0.001, deadline - time.monotonic()))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            raise ValueError("child wall limit") from exc
        if code != 0:
            raise ValueError("child exited nonzero")
        return bytes(output[0]) if raw else decode(bytes(output[0]))
    finally:
        selector.close()
        for stream in [p.stdin, p.stdout, p.stderr]:
            stream.close()
        reap_group(p)


def submission(entry):
    if entry.parent.is_symlink() or entry.name != "main.py" or entry.is_symlink() or not entry.is_file():
        raise ValueError("entry must be a regular main.py")
    if not (entry.parent / "engine.cpp").is_file():
        raise ValueError("engine.cpp is required by the native stage contract")
    total = count = 0
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(entry.parent, followlinks=False):
        for name in dirs + files:
            path = Path(base) / name
            mode = path.lstat()
            count += 1
            if stat.S_ISDIR(mode.st_mode):
                continue
            if not stat.S_ISREG(mode.st_mode) or mode.st_nlink != 1 or path.suffix not in (".py", ".cpp", ".hpp"):
                raise ValueError("unsafe submission entry")
            total += mode.st_size
    if total > 1024**2 or count > 64:
        raise ValueError("submission budget")


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("entry", type=Path)
    args = p.parse_args()
    if os.geteuid() == 0:
        print("Infrastructure error: run public checks inside the nonroot environment.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    def interrupted(signum, frame):
        raise InterruptedError('public checker interrupted')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    # Check before resolve(), so symlinks cannot bypass the entry rule.
    try:
        submission(args.entry.absolute())
        entry = args.entry.absolute()
        examples = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "examples"
        fixtures = sorted(examples.glob("*.in.json"))
        if not fixtures:
            raise RuntimeError("public fixtures missing")
        for fixture in fixtures:
            expected = decode(fixture.with_name(fixture.name.replace(".in.", ".out.")).read_bytes())
            payload = fixture.read_bytes()
            actual = run_child(entry, payload)
            try:
                request = decode(payload)
            except ValueError:
                request = None
            audit(request, actual, expected)
        binary = Path('/workspace/tmp') / ('public-engine-' + str(os.getpid()))
        run_child(entry, b'', argv=['g++', '-O2', '-std=c++17', str(entry.parent/'engine.cpp'), '-o', str(binary)], raw=True)
        native_fixtures = sorted(examples.glob('*.in.native'))
        if not native_fixtures:
            raise RuntimeError('public native fixtures missing')
        for fixture in native_fixtures:
            expected = fixture.with_name(fixture.name.replace('.in.', '.out.')).read_bytes()
            actual = run_child(entry, fixture.read_bytes(), argv=[str(binary)], raw=True)
            if actual.split() != expected.split():
                raise ValueError('native stage output')
    except (CleanupProfileError, ChildCleanupError) as exc:
        print("Infrastructure error: " + str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except (ValueError, OSError, RecursionError) as exc:
        print("FAIL: " + str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("PASS: all public child-process checks")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
==========
"""Public wire/result auditor. Does not compute an optimal layout."""
import bisect
import ipaddress
import re
import struct

WIDTH = (16,8,4)
LANES = (4,8,16)


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def exact(a,b):
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return False
    if type(a) is dict:
        return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(exact(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list:
        return len(a)==len(b) and all(exact(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return a==b


def shape(value, names):
    require(type(value) is dict and set(value)==set(names),"output object shape")


def decode_image(text, starts, hops):
    require(type(text) is str and len(text)%2==0 and
            re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]*",text) is not None,"image hex")
    raw = bytes.fromhex(text)
    require(len(raw)>=128 and len(raw)%64==0,"image size")
    require(raw[:8]==b"FIDX"+bytes([2,0,0,0]) and raw[24:64]==bytes(40),"image header")
    runs,count,hopoff,total = struct.unpack_from("<IIII",raw,8)
    require(runs==len(starts) and total==len(raw) and 1<=count<=2*runs-1,"header counts")
    require(hopoff%64==0 and 64<hopoff<=len(raw),"hop offset")
    require(total==hopoff+(runs*4+63)//64*64,"hop array size")
    decoded_hops=[]
    for x in struct.unpack_from("<"+"I"*runs,raw,hopoff):
        require(x==0xffffffff or x<=2147483647,"hop encoding")
        decoded_hops.append(None if x==0xffffffff else x)
    require(exact(decoded_hops,hops) and not any(raw[hopoff+4*runs:]),"hop array")
    offset,nodes,order=64,{},[]
    for _ in range(count):
        require(offset+32<=hopoff,"truncated node")
        kind,mode,cached,reserved,lo,span,num,reserved2,allocated=struct.unpack_from("<BBBBHHHHI",raw,offset)
        require(kind in (0,1) and mode in (0,1,2) and cached in (0,1),"node tag")
        require(reserved==reserved2==0 and 1<=span<=runs and lo+span<=runs,"node range")
        children_count=num if kind==0 else 0
        require((kind==0 and 2<=num<=9 and num<=span) or
                (kind==1 and num==span and 1<=span<=8),"node count")
        keys_count=num-1 if kind==0 else span
        used=32+4*children_count+keys_count*WIDTH[mode]
        require(allocated==(used+63)//64*64 and offset+allocated<=hopoff,"node allocation")
        require(not any(raw[offset+used:offset+allocated]),"node padding")
        base=int.from_bytes(raw[offset+16:offset+32],"little")
        require(base==starts[lo],"node base")
        spread=starts[lo+span-1]-base
        require(mode==0 or spread<(1<<(64 if mode==1 else 32)),"mode range")
        at=offset+32
        children=list(struct.unpack_from("<"+"I"*children_count,raw,at)) if children_count else []
        at+=4*children_count
        keys=[]
        for k in range(keys_count):
            value=int.from_bytes(raw[at:at+WIDTH[mode]],"little")
            keys.append(value+base if mode else value)
            at+=WIDTH[mode]
        nodes[offset]={"kind":kind,"mode":mode,"cached":cached,"lo":lo,"span":span,
                       "children":children,"keys":keys,"pages":allocated//64}
        order.append(offset)
        offset+=allocated
    require(offset==hopoff,"unaccounted node bytes")
    queue,seen=[64],set()
    require(nodes[64]["lo"]==0 and nodes[64]["span"]==runs,"root range")
    for off in queue:
        require(off in nodes and off not in seen,"bad tree offset")
        seen.add(off)
        node=nodes[off]
        if node["kind"]==1:
            require(node["keys"]==starts[node["lo"]:node["lo"]+node["span"]],"leaf keys")
        else:
            cursor=node["lo"]
            expected_keys=[]
            for c,childoff in enumerate(node["children"]):
                require(childoff in nodes,"child offset")
                child=nodes[childoff]
                require(child["lo"]==cursor,"child partition")
                if c:
                    expected_keys.append(starts[cursor])
                cursor+=child["span"]
            require(cursor==node["lo"]+node["span"] and node["keys"]==expected_keys,"internal keys")
            queue.extend(node["children"])
    require(queue==order,"breadth first layout or unreachable nodes")
    return nodes,len(raw)//64


def audit(request, actual, expected):
    if type(expected) is dict and "error" in expected:
        require(exact(actual,expected),"invalid response")
        return
    shape(actual,["cases"])
    require(type(actual["cases"]) is list and len(actual["cases"])==len(expected["cases"]),"case count")
    for rawcase,result,gold in zip(request["cases"],actual["cases"],expected["cases"]):
        shape(result,["versions","changes","bursts","objective"])
        require(type(result["versions"]) is list and len(result["versions"])==len(gold["versions"]),"version count")
        require(exact(result["changes"],gold["changes"]),"forwarding changes")
        require(type(result["objective"]) is list and len(result["objective"])==2 and
                all(type(x) is int and x>=0 for x in result["objective"]),"objective types")
        require(type(result["bursts"]) is list and len(result["bursts"])==len(rawcase["bursts"]),"burst count")
        allnodes,allstarts,allhops=[],[],[]
        pages=resident=work=0
        for version,gv in zip(result["versions"],gold["versions"]):
            shape(version,["starts","hops","image"])
            require(exact(version["starts"],gv["starts"]) and exact(version["hops"],gv["hops"]),"forwarding atlas")
            starts=[int(x,16) for x in version["starts"]]
            nodes,size=decode_image(version["image"],starts,version["hops"])
            pages+=size
            resident+=sum(n["pages"] for n in nodes.values() if n["cached"])
            allnodes.append(nodes)
            allstarts.append(starts)
            allhops.append(version["hops"])
        require(resident<=rawcase["cache_pages"],"resident page budget")
        costs=rawcase["costs"]
        for burst,answers in zip(rawcase["bursts"],result["bursts"]):
            v,repeat=burst["version"],burst["repeat"]
            starts,nodes,hops=allstarts[v],allnodes[v],allhops[v]
            require(type(answers) is list and len(answers)==len(burst["addresses"]),"answer count")
            visits,touched={},set()
            for text,answer in zip(burst["addresses"],answers):
                address=int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(text))
                off,path=64,[]
                while True:
                    path.append(off)
                    visits[off]=visits.get(off,0)+1
                    touched.add(off)
                    node=nodes[off]
                    if node["kind"]==1:
                        run=node["lo"]+bisect.bisect_right(node["keys"],address)-1
                        require(node["lo"]<=run<node["lo"]+node["span"],"leaf predecessor")
                        break
                    off=node["children"][bisect.bisect_right(node["keys"],address)]
                require(exact(answer,[hops[run],run,path]),"lookup path/result")
            for off in touched:
                n=nodes[off]
                k=len(n["keys"])
                work+=repeat*(n["pages"]*(costs["hit"] if n["cached"] else costs["miss"])
                              +((k+LANES[n["mode"]]-1)//LANES[n["mode"]]+costs["decode"][n["mode"]])*visits[off])
        require(exact(result["objective"],[work,pages]),"reported objective")
        require(exact(result["objective"],gold["objective"]),"nonoptimal public layout")

"""Public checker process ownership and the published scored child restrictions."""
import ctypes
import errno
import os
import signal
import time

class CleanupProfileError(RuntimeError):
    pass

class ChildCleanupError(RuntimeError):
    pass

_READY=False

class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('code',ctypes.c_ushort),('jt',ctypes.c_ubyte),('jf',ctypes.c_ubyte),('k',ctypes.c_uint)]

class Program(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('length',ctypes.c_ushort),('instructions',ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]

def prepare_controller():
    global _READY
    if _READY:
        return
    try:
        # Signal0 targets this checker only and sends no signal.
        os.kill(os.getpid(),0)
    except PermissionError as exc:
        raise CleanupProfileError('public checker needs the documented public-development controller profile (kill/setsid); scored candidate profile is unchanged') from exc
    libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
    if libc.prctl(36,1,0,0,0)!=0:
        raise CleanupProfileError('public checker cannot enable child subreaping')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGCHLD,signal.SIG_DFL)
    _READY=True

def restrict_child():
    # Executed before candidate/compiler exec, after creating its private session.
    # Full Linux x86-64 filter equals the published scored worker filter.
    rows=[(0x20,0,0,4),(0x15,1,0,0xc000003e),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000),
          (0x20,0,0,0),(0x35,0,1,0x40000000),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000)]
    denied=[41, 53, 42, 29, 30, 31, 64, 65, 66, 220, 68, 69, 70, 71, 62, 200, 234, 101, 310, 311, 272, 308, 165, 166, 155, 161, 112, 109, 105, 106, 113, 114, 117, 119, 116, 304, 303, 321, 250, 248, 249, 298, 323, 425, 426, 427, 438]
    for number in denied:
        rows.extend([(0x15,0,1,number),(0x06,0,0,0x50000|errno.EPERM)])
    rows.extend([(0x15,0,1,435),(0x06,0,0,0x50000|errno.ENOSYS),
                 (0x15,0,4,56),(0x20,0,0,16),(0x45,0,1,0x7e820000),
                 (0x06,0,0,0x50000|errno.EPERM),(0x20,0,0,0),(0x06,0,0,0x7fff0000)])
    filters=(Filter*len(rows))(*(Filter(*row) for row in rows))
    program=Program(len(rows),filters)
    libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
    if libc.prctl(38,1,0,0,0)!=0 or libc.prctl(22,2,ctypes.byref(program),0,0)!=0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(),'cannot install scored child restrictions')

def reap_group(process):
    """Kill/reap only this child's group, including adopted orphan descendants."""
    group=process.pid
    if group<=1:
        raise ChildCleanupError('unsafe child process-group identity')
    previous=signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK,{signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM})
    end=time.monotonic()+5
    try:
        while True:
            try:
                # WNOWAIT retains an owned child as a group identity anchor.
                # ECHILD means no owned group remains: never signal a reused ID.
                os.waitid(os.P_PGID,group,os.WEXITED|os.WNOHANG|os.WNOWAIT)
            except ChildProcessError:
                return
            try:
                os.killpg(group,signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            except PermissionError as exc:
                raise ChildCleanupError('public controller cannot kill its owned child group') from exc
            while True:
                try:
                    pid,status=os.waitpid(-group,os.WNOHANG)
                except ChildProcessError:
                    return
                if pid==0:
                    break
                if pid==process.pid:
                    process.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
            if time.monotonic()>=end:
                raise ChildCleanupError('owned child group could not be reaped within cleanup guard')
            time.sleep(0.005)
    finally:
        signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK,previous)

"""Scalar C++17 subsystem transport, built only inside the nonroot worker."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import sys

_BINARY = None


def build():
    global _BINARY
    if _BINARY is None:
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        scratch = Path('/workspace/tmp')
        _BINARY = scratch / ('lookup-' + str(os.getpid()))
        env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=str(scratch))
        subprocess.run(['g++', '-O2', '-std=c++17', str(root / 'engine.cpp'),
                        '-o', str(_BINARY)], check=True, env=env)
    return _BINARY


def run(lines):
    result = subprocess.run([str(build())],
                            input=('\n'.join(lines) + '\n').encode(),
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                            check=False)
    if result.returncode:
        sys.stderr.buffer.write(result.stderr)
        raise RuntimeError('native stage failed')
    return result.stdout.decode().splitlines()


def atlas(routes):
    """RIB routes -> (starts, hops) maximal forwarding runs."""
    lines = ['ATLAS ' + str(len(routes))]
    lines += ['%032x %d %d' % (start, length, hop)
              for (start, length), hop in routes.items()]
    result = run(lines)
    if len(result) != 1 + int(result[0]):
        raise RuntimeError('native atlas framing')
    rows = [line.split() for line in result[1:]]
    return ([int(a, 16) for a, _h in rows],
            [None if h == '-1' else int(h) for _a, h in rows])


def image_for(starts, hops, rows):
    """Layout rows -> packed FIDX version-2 image hexadecimal text."""
    lines = ['PACK %d %d 0' % (len(starts), len(rows))]
    lines += ['%032x %d' % (s, -1 if h is None else h)
              for s, h in zip(starts, hops)]
    for lo, span, mode, cached, children in rows:
        lines.append(' '.join(map(str, [lo, span, mode, cached,
                                        len(children)] + list(children))))
    output = run(lines)
    if len(output) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('native pack framing')
    return output[0]


def pack(starts, hops, tree, addresses):
    nodes = [tree]
    for node in nodes:
        nodes.extend(node['children'])
    indices = {id(n): i for i, n in enumerate(nodes)}
    lines = ['PACK %d %d %d' % (len(starts), len(nodes), len(addresses))]
    lines += ['%032x %d' % (x, -1 if h is None else h)
              for x, h in zip(starts, hops)]
    for node in nodes:
        children = [indices[id(c)] for c in node['children']]
        row = [node['lo'], node['span'], node['mode'], node['cached'],
               len(children), *children]
        lines.append(' '.join(map(str, row)))
    lines += ['%032x' % x for x in addresses]
    output = run(lines)
    if len(output) != len(addresses) + 1:
        raise RuntimeError('native pack framing')
    answers = []
    for line in output[1:]:
        hop, rank, count, *path = map(int, line.split())
        if count != len(path):
            raise RuntimeError('native path framing')
        answers.append([None if hop == -1 else hop, rank, path])
    return output[0], answers


def trace(image, addresses):
    rows = run(['TRACE ' + str(len(addresses)), image,
                *['%032x' % x for x in addresses]])
    if len(rows) != len(addresses):
        raise RuntimeError('native trace framing')
    answers = []
    for row in rows:
        hop, rank, count, *path = map(int, row.split())
        if count != len(path):
            raise RuntimeError('native trace path framing')
        answers.append([None if hop == -1 else hop, rank, path])
    return answers


def plan(cache_pages, costs, runs, burst_runs):
    """One case -> optimal layout rows per version.

    runs is [(starts, hops), ...]; burst_runs is a parallel list of
    [(repeat, [run index per address occurrence]), ...] for that version.
    """
    hit, miss, dec = costs
    lines = ['PLAN %d %d %d %d %d %d %d' % (len(runs), cache_pages, hit, miss,
                                            dec[0], dec[1], dec[2])]
    for vi, (starts, hops) in enumerate(runs):
        lines.append(str(len(starts)))
        lines += ['%032x %d' % (s, -1 if h is None else h)
                  for s, h in zip(starts, hops)]
        bursts = burst_runs[vi]
        lines.append(str(len(bursts)))
        for repeat, runs_of in bursts:
            lines.append('%d %d%s' % (repeat, len(runs_of),
                                      ''.join(' %d' % x for x in runs_of)))
    output = run(lines)
    trees = []
    pos = 0
    for _vi in range(len(runs)):
        if pos >= len(output):
            raise RuntimeError('native plan framing')
        count = int(output[pos])
        pos += 1
        rows = []
        for _k in range(count):
            if pos >= len(output):
                raise RuntimeError('native plan framing')
            parts = output[pos].split()
            pos += 1
            lo, span, mode, cached, children = (int(x) for x in parts[:5])
            kids = [int(x) for x in parts[5:]]
            if len(kids) != children:
                raise RuntimeError('native plan framing')
            rows.append((lo, span, mode, cached, kids))
        trees.append(rows)
    if pos != len(output):
        raise RuntimeError('native plan trailing output')
    return trees

"""Maximum-batch scale and wall-clock test."""
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from audit import audit, decode_image
from reference import text_of, U

ENTRY = ['python3', '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py']


def big_case(rng, nprefix=64, nextra=29936, ntx=1, nbursts=128, per=64):
    """One case: nprefix covering prefixes, many same-hop /128 aliases."""
    assert nprefix <= 64
    length = 0
    while (1 << length) < nprefix:
        length += 1
    assert (1 << length) == nprefix
    initial = []
    hops = {}
    for k in range(nprefix):
        start = k << (128 - length)
        hop = rng.randrange(1, 2 ** 31)
        initial.append([text_of(start) + '/' + str(length), hop])
        hops[start] = hop
    extra = []
    for _ in range(nextra):
        base = rng.choice(list(hops))
        offset = rng.randrange(0, 1 << (128 - length))
        addr = base + offset
        extra.append([text_of(addr) + '/' + '128', hops[base]])
    initial = extra + initial
    # A transaction that erases a same-hop alias: runs stay identical.
    txs = []
    for _ in range(ntx):
        victim = extra[rng.randrange(len(extra))]
        txs.append([['erase', victim[0]]])
    bursts = []
    count = 0
    starts_used = [k << (128 - length) for k in range(nprefix)]
    for bi in range(nbursts):
        room = min(per, 8192 - count)
        if room <= 0:
            break
        addrs = []
        for _ in range(room):
            pick = rng.random()
            if pick < 0.5:
                addrs.append(text_of(rng.choice(starts_used) + rng.randrange(0, 5)))
            else:
                addrs.append(text_of(rng.randrange(0, U)))
        count += len(addrs)
        bursts.append({'version': rng.randrange(0, ntx + 1),
                       'repeat': rng.choice([1, 7, 1000, 100000]),
                       'addresses': addrs})
    hit = rng.randrange(1, 17)
    return {'initial': initial, 'transactions': txs, 'bursts': bursts,
            'cache_pages': rng.randrange(0, 13),
            'costs': {'hit': hit, 'miss': min(256, hit + rng.randrange(0, 200)),
                      'decode': [rng.randrange(0, 17) for _ in range(3)]}}


def many_small_cases(rng, ncases=4, ntx=7):
    """Many versions with a few runs each: transport and process overhead."""
    cases = []
    for _ in range(ncases):
        initial, txs = [], []
        for _ in range(6):
            length = rng.choice([8, 16, 32, 64, 128])
            start = 0 if length == 0 else rng.randrange(0, 1 << length) << (128 - length)
            initial.append([text_of(start) + '/' + str(length), rng.randrange(0, 30)])
        for _ in range(ntx):
            tx = []
            for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 4)):
                length = rng.choice([8, 16, 32, 64, 128])
                start = 0 if length == 0 else rng.randrange(0, 1 << length) << (128 - length)
                if rng.random() < 0.6:
                    tx.append(['set', text_of(start) + '/' + str(length),
                               rng.randrange(0, 30)])
                else:
                    tx.append(['erase', text_of(start) + '/' + str(length)])
            txs.append(tx)
        bursts = []
        for v in range(ntx + 1):
            if rng.random() < 0.7:
                bursts.append({'version': v, 'repeat': rng.randrange(1, 100000),
                               'addresses': [text_of(rng.randrange(0, U))
                                             for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 8))]})
        hit = rng.randrange(1, 17)
        cases.append({'initial': initial, 'transactions': txs, 'bursts': bursts,
                      'cache_pages': rng.randrange(0, 13),
                      'costs': {'hit': hit, 'miss': min(256, hit + rng.randrange(0, 200)),
                                'decode': [rng.randrange(0, 17) for _ in range(3)]}})
    return cases


def main(mode):
    rng = random.Random(99)
    if mode == 'big':
        payload = json.dumps({'cases': [big_case(rng)]})
    elif mode == 'many':
        payload = json.dumps({'cases': many_small_cases(rng)})
    elif mode == 'huge':
        cases = [big_case(rng, nprefix=64, nextra=29936, ntx=1, nbursts=128, per=64)]
        payload = json.dumps({'cases': cases})
    else:
        raise SystemExit('mode?')
    print('input bytes', len(payload))
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(ENTRY, input=payload.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                       stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print('elapsed %.2fs rc %d stderr %s' % (dt, p.returncode,
                                             p.stderr.decode()[:600]))
    if p.returncode:
        return 1
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    print('output bytes', len(p.stdout))
    if 'error' in out:
        print('REJECTED', out)
        return 1
    for ci, res in enumerate(out['cases']):
        print('case', ci, 'objective', res['objective'],
              'versions', len(res['versions']),
              'image bytes', sum(len(v['image']) // 2 for v in res['versions']))
        total_runs = sum(len(v['starts']) for v in res['versions'])
        print('   total runs', total_runs)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1]))

"""Full structural validation of a compiler result against its request."""
import bisect
import ipaddress as ip
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from audit import decode_image, LANES
from reference import reference_changes, reference_runs, U
from protocol import parse_request


def histories_of(request):
    out = []
    for case in request:
        fib = {}
        for route, hop in case['initial']:
            fib[route] = hop
        versions = [dict(fib)]
        for tx in case['transactions']:
            for op, route, hop in tx:
                if op == 'set':
                    fib[route] = hop
                elif route in fib:
                    del fib[route]
            versions.append(dict(fib))
        out.append(versions)
    return out


def walk(nodes, address):
    off, path = 64, []
    while True:
        path.append(off)
        node = nodes[off]
        rank = bisect.bisect_right(node['keys'], address)
        if node['kind'] == 1:
            return node['lo'] + rank - 1, path
        off = node['children'][rank]


def validate(payload_text, actual):
    """Raise AssertionError on any disagreement; return per-case objectives."""
    request = parse_request(payload_text.encode() if isinstance(payload_text, str)
                            else payload_text)
    assert set(actual) == {'cases'}
    assert len(actual['cases']) == len(request)
    objectives = []
    histories = histories_of(request)
    for ci, (case, result) in enumerate(zip(request, actual['cases'])):
        assert set(result) == {'versions', 'changes', 'bursts', 'objective'}, 'shape'
        assert len(result['versions']) == len(histories[ci])
        starts_all, hops_all, nodes_all = [], [], []
        pages = 0
        for vi, v in enumerate(result['versions']):
            assert set(v) == {'starts', 'hops', 'image'}
            es, eh = reference_runs(histories[ci][vi])
            assert v['starts'] == ['%032x' % x for x in es], (ci, vi, 'starts')
            assert v['hops'] == eh, (ci, vi, 'hops')
            assert v['starts'] == sorted(set(v['starts'])), 'strictly increasing'
            assert v['starts'][0] == '0' * 32, 'starts at zero'
            starts = [int(x, 16) for x in v['starts']]
            starts_all.append(starts)
            hops_all.append(v['hops'])
            nodes, size = decode_image(v['image'], starts, v['hops'])
            pages += size
            nodes_all.append(nodes)
        resident = sum(n['pages'] for nodes in nodes_all for n in nodes.values()
                       if n['cached'])
        assert resident <= case['cache_pages'], ('resident', resident)
        hit, miss, dec = case['costs']
        work = 0
        assert len(result['bursts']) == len(case['bursts'])
        for burst, answers in zip(case['bursts'], result['bursts']):
            v, repeat, addresses = burst
            nodes, hops = nodes_all[v], hops_all[v]
            assert len(answers) == len(addresses)
            visits, touched = {}, set()
            for address, answer in zip(addresses, answers):
                a = int(ip.IPv6Address(address))
                run, path = walk(nodes, a)
                assert answer == [hops[run], run, path], ('answer', answer)
                for off in path:
                    visits[off] = visits.get(off, 0) + 1
                touched.update(path)
            for off in touched:
                node = nodes[off]
                k = len(node['keys'])
                work += repeat * (node['pages'] * (hit if node['cached'] else miss)
                                  + ((k + LANES[node['mode']] - 1) // LANES[node['mode']]
                                     + dec[node['mode']]) * visits[off])
        changes = [reference_changes((starts_all[v], hops_all[v]),
                                     (starts_all[v + 1], hops_all[v + 1]))
                   for v in range(len(starts_all) - 1)]
        assert result['changes'] == changes, ('changes', result['changes'], changes)
        assert result['objective'] == [work, pages], \
            ('objective', result['objective'], [work, pages])
        objectives.append([work, pages])
    return objectives

"""Cache-budgeted IPv6 forwarding-image compiler (protocol 3).

Version 0 is the initial FIB and every transaction publishes a new immutable
version.  Each version is compiled to its unique maximal forwarding runs and
then to a packed FIDX version-2 search image.  Tree shape, node encoding and
residency are chosen jointly over every version of a case under the shared
resident-page budget, minimizing the published (work, image_pages) pair.
"""
import bisect
import json
import struct
import sys

import native
from protocol import Invalid, MAX_INPUT, parse_request

WIDTH = (16, 8, 4)
LANES = (4, 8, 16)
U = 1 << 128
MAX_RUNS_PER_VERSION = 64
MAX_RUNS_TOTAL = 128


def key(value):
    """Lowercase 32-digit bound; the domain top keeps its leading one."""
    return "%032x" % value


def decode_image(text, starts, hops):
    """Reconstruct the node structure of a packed image from its own bytes."""
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) % 2 or \
            any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in text):
        raise RuntimeError("image hex")
    raw = bytes.fromhex(text)
    if len(raw) < 128 or len(raw) % 64:
        raise RuntimeError("image size")
    if raw[:8] != b"FIDX" + bytes([2, 0, 0, 0]) or raw[24:64] != bytes(40):
        raise RuntimeError("image header")
    runs, count, hopoff, total = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", raw, 8)
    if runs != len(starts) or total != len(raw) or not 1 <= count <= 2 * runs - 1:
        raise RuntimeError("header counts")
    if hopoff % 64 or not 64 < hopoff <= len(raw):
        raise RuntimeError("hop offset")
    if total != hopoff + (runs * 4 + 63) // 64 * 64:
        raise RuntimeError("hop array size")
    decoded = []
    for x in struct.unpack_from("<" + "I" * runs, raw, hopoff):
        if x != 0xffffffff and x > 2147483647:
            raise RuntimeError("hop encoding")
        decoded.append(None if x == 0xffffffff else x)
    if decoded != hops or any(raw[hopoff + 4 * runs:]):
        raise RuntimeError("hop array")
    nodes, order, offset = {}, [], 64
    while offset < hopoff:
        if offset + 32 > hopoff:
            raise RuntimeError("truncated node")
        kind, mode, cached, reserved, lo, span, num, reserved2, allocated = \
            struct.unpack_from("<BBBBHHHHI", raw, offset)
        if kind not in (0, 1) or mode not in (0, 1, 2) or cached not in (0, 1):
            raise RuntimeError("node tag")
.....
    old_starts, old_hops = left
    new_starts, new_hops = right
    bounds = sorted(set(old_starts) | set(new_starts))
    rows, total = [], len(bounds)
    for k in range(total):
        start = bounds[k]
        end = bounds[k + 1] if k + 1 < total else U
        old = old_hops[bisect.bisect_right(old_starts, start) - 1]
        new = new_hops[bisect.bisect_right(new_starts, start) - 1]
        if old == new:
            continue
        if rows and rows[-1][1] == start and rows[-1][2] == old and rows[-1][3] == new:
            rows[-1][1] = end
        else:
            rows.append([start, end, old, new])
    return [[key(a), key(b), o, n] for a, b, o, n in rows]


def compile_request(cases):
    if not cases:
        return {"cases": []}
    histories = [commit_versions(case) for case in cases]
    # Canonical forwarding runs of every committed version; these also carry
    # the per-version and whole-request run bounds of the request domain.
    atlases, total_runs = [], 0
    for case, versions in zip(cases, histories):
        runs = []
        for routes in versions:
            starts, hops = native.atlas(routes)
            if len(starts) > MAX_RUNS_PER_VERSION:
                raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
            total_runs += len(starts)
            if total_runs > MAX_RUNS_TOTAL:
                raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
            runs.append((starts, hops))
        atlases.append(runs)
    visit_runs = []
    for case, runs in zip(cases, atlases):
        per_version = [[] for _ in runs]
        for version, repeat, addresses in case["bursts"]:
            starts = runs[version][0]
            indices = [bisect.bisect_right(starts, a) - 1 for a in addresses]
            per_version[version].append((repeat, indices))
        visit_runs.append(per_version)
    results = []
    for case, runs, burst_runs in zip(cases, atlases, visit_runs):
        hit, miss, dec = case["costs"]
        trees = native.plan(case["cache_pages"], case["costs"], runs, burst_runs)
        versions, nodes_all = [], []
        pages = resident = 0
        for vi, (starts, hops) in enumerate(runs):
            image = native.image_for(starts, hops, trees[vi])
            nodes, size = decode_image(image, starts, hops)
            pages += size
            resident += sum(n["pages"] for n in nodes.values() if n["cached"])
            nodes_all.append(nodes)
            versions.append({"starts": [key(s) for s in starts],
                             "hops": list(hops), "image": image})
        if resident > case["cache_pages"]:
            raise RuntimeError("resident page budget")
        changes = [diff_versions(runs[v], runs[v + 1]) for v in range(len(runs) - 1)]
        work, bursts = 0, []
        for version, repeat, addresses in case["bursts"]:
            nodes, hops = nodes_all[version], runs[version][1]
            visits, touched, answers = {}, set(), []
            for address in addresses:
                run, path = walk(nodes, address)
                answers.append([hops[run], run, path])
                for offset in path:
                    visits[offset] = visits.get(offset, 0) + 1
                touched.update(path)
            for offset in touched:
                node = nodes[offset]
                keys = len(node["keys"])
                work += repeat * (node["pages"] * (hit if node["cached"] else miss)
                                  + ((keys + LANES[node["mode"]] - 1) // LANES[node["mode"]]
                                     + dec[node["mode"]]) * visits[offset])
            bursts.append(answers)
        results.append({"versions": versions, "changes": changes,
                        "bursts": bursts, "objective": [work, pages]})
    return {"cases": results}


def main():
    try:
        cases = parse_request(sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT + 1))
        result = compile_request(cases)
    except Invalid:
        result = {"error": "invalid"}
    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def version_frontier(starts, bursts, C, hit, miss, dec):

    R = len(starts)

    for x in weights:

        return work * SCALE + P

def case_optimum(frontiers, C, fixed):
    best = None

        nonlocal best

    return best
